protocol.name: aqueous_window_info_v1

description.summary: Aqueous window introspection and workspace layout control

protocol.description:
This protocol augments ext_foreign_toplevel_handle_v1 with compositor policy information useful to diagnostics and window-rule authoring.
Enumeration and stable identifiers remain owned by ext_foreign_toplevel_list_v1. Version 3 adds narrowly scoped control of the active workspace layout on a named output. Version 4 reports the window's committed wp_content_type_v1 state and content-type rule matchers.

interface.name: aqueous_window_info_manager_v1
interface.description: Create a one-shot information snapshot for an Aqueous toplevel.

entry.name: invalid_toplevel
entry.summary: the foreign toplevel handle is not owned by Aqueous

request.name: get_window_info
request.description: The returned object receives all currently available properties followed by done. Properties without a meaningful value are omitted.

request.name: get_scene_snapshot
request.description: The returned object emits a stable, one-shot view of the current scene graph. Node identifiers are local to the snapshot and reveal no server pointers or other compositor-private identifiers.

description.summary: query the active workspace layout on an output

request.name: set_active_workspace_layout

description.summary: change the active workspace layout on an output

request.description: The layout change is applied immediately and remains a runtime override until the compositor exits.

arg.name: layout
arg.summary: tile, monocle, grid, rows, dwindle, reverse-dwindle, scrolling, float, game-mode, or composable

description.summary: result of a layout query or change

arg.name: layout
arg.summary: effective layout, or empty on failure

interface.name: aqueous_window_info_v1
interface.description: A read-only snapshot of compositor-owned state for one mapped toplevel.

event.name: content_type
event.description: Omitted when the client has not committed a content type.

arg.name: content_type
arg.summary: zero none, one photo, two video, three game

description.summary: a matcher belonging to the matched rule
the complete snapshot has been sent

interface.name: aqueous_scene_snapshot_v1
interface.description: A read-only, pre-order snapshot of the wlroots scene graph. Parent zero identifies the root. Positions are relative to the parent node.

event.name: node
event.description: Nodes are emitted in render order. Width and height are zero for tree nodes and for buffers without a current destination size.

arg.name: parent
arg.summary: parent identifier, or zero for the root

description.summary: the complete scene snapshot has been sent
